Read in the name of your Lord who made you.
He made man from a tiny clinging drop.
Read! Your Lord is the Most Giving.
He is the One who taught by the pen.
He taught man what he did not know.
When he thinks he does not need anyone.
Truly, to your Lord is the return.
Have you seen the one who stops.
A servant of Allah when he prays?
Have you seen if that servant is on the right way?
Or if he tells people to be good?
Have you seen if the one who stops him says no and turns away?
Does he not know that Allah sees?
No! If he does not stop, We will drag him by the front of his head.
A head that lies and does wrong.
Then let him call his friends.
We will call the guards of Hell.
No! Do not obey him. Bow down and come close to Allah.
